      About this data

      Typical home value by county

      Every US county shaded by typical home value (zhvi) — drag the year slider or press ▶ to animate 2000–2025. Colors use one pooled quantile scale across all years, so shades are comparable over time. Click a county for its value and that year's national rank. Grey = no estimate. 3,063 of 3,235 countys have 2025 data.

      Source: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI): smoothed, seasonally-adjusted typical value of homes in the 35th-65th percentile (single-family + condo), one June frame per year, 2000-2025. Not a transaction median; rural counties without enough sales history show no estimate. Data provided by Zillow
